description: The image shows a divided roadway with no visible pedestrian sidewalk or curbside walking space; the edges appear to be continuous asphalt with a low curb/shoulder and a metal guardrail on the right. Traffic is separated by lane markings only, with multiple lanes in each direction and no physical barriers between the roadway and the walking edge, which would make pedestrian crossing/side-walking unsafe. There is some greenery along both sides (hedges and shrubs) and streetlights, but there are no visible curb cuts, ramps, or pedestrian-scale accessibility features, and the only clear separation from traffic is the guardrail on the right.
